headspace.title: Headspace · Sleep
headspace.finding: Sleepcasts, music, soundscapes and wind-down content support separate ritual and audio destinations. The specific routine, timer and navigation below are WDA proposals.

planta.title: Planta
planta.finding: Plant care, plant collections and journals inform a plant-centered structure. The painterly presentation remains Pocket Garden’s original direction.

planta-start.title: Planta · Getting started
planta-start.finding: Adding plants to sites, completing or postponing tasks, and keeping plant notes inform setup → garden → care → observation.

planta-care.title: Planta · Custom care
planta-care.finding: Custom tasks can have descriptions and recurrence. Pocket Garden uses an observation before recording care; it does not assume every reminder requires watering.

cozi.title: Cozi · Feature overview
cozi.finding: Shared calendars, reminders and lists support a household agenda. Home Note’s invitation, acknowledgement and handover details are proposed here, not copied native flows.

weather.title: Apple · Check the weather
weather.finding: Current conditions and forecast detail support a summary-to-detail hierarchy. Soul’s city, preferences and daylight routes are WDA design decisions.

hue.title: I Love Hue · Official product page
hue.finding: Calm visual arrangement informs the play loop. Horizontal botanical strips, snapping rules and tap alternatives are Petal-specific proposals.

structured.title: Structured
structured.finding: A visual timeline and calendar integration inform Daybook’s planning structure. Its daylight landscape and saved places remain original to this study.

structured-tasks.title: Structured · Create and edit tasks
structured-tasks.finding: Task creation, date/time/duration editing and saving back into the timeline support an explicit editor. Daybook additionally preserves drafts and derives the duration from start/end.

onboarding.title: Apple · Onboarding
onboarding.finding: Reference retained from the research plan. Full article could not be read through the text fetch, so no specific behavior is attributed to it. The proposed short setup sequences are WDA decisions.

forms.title: W3C · Validating input
forms.finding: Label required fields and expose accessible validation feedback. Validate on the server as well as the client. Failed saves should keep the user’s draft.

dialog.title: W3C · Modal dialog pattern
dialog.finding: Modal focus stays inside the dialog; Escape closes it. Restore useful focus on return. Dirty drafts require an explicit discard choice.

drag.title: W3C · Dragging movements
drag.finding: Provide a single-pointer alternative to dragging. Petal uses tap a strip, then its target, with keyboard support in addition.

tabs.title: W3C · Tabs pattern
tabs.finding: In-page tabs need matching panels and keyboard behavior. The study’s bottom destinations are route navigation: implement links with aria-current, rather than applying tab semantics to unrelated pages.

motion.title: MDN · Reduced motion
motion.finding: Respect the system’s request to reduce nonessential movement. Motion is never the only signal that an action succeeded.

permission.title: MDN · Notification permission
permission.finding: Permission can be granted, denied or undecided. Keep reminder state separate from requested permission and retain a usable path after refusal.
